rang gi sems kyi dri ma yongs su sbyong bas na/ yongs sbyong zhes pa'i ming gis bstan no// nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa ni/ gnyen po'i chos nyams su blangs pas spang bya mi mthun phyogs las nges par 'byung bas/ nges 'byung sgrub pa zhes bya'o// de yang dper na/ yul ljongs na rgyal po gnyis 'thab/ gang la 'thab na/ 'dod pa'i yon tan la 'thab/ ji ltar 'thab na/ dang por las mi 'thu/ de nas dmag phyogs gcig tu gsog go cha ma gyon par g.yul du mi 'jug go cha gyon nas ru shom byed/ ru bshams nas 'thab/ ru mtshon dang 'dra ba'i gtso bos dmag dpon byed/ rnga skad dang sbyar ba'i mda' 'phen/ dus tshod dang sbyar ba'i rgyal pham brtsi ba de bzhin du/ yul ljongs dang 'dra ba'i chos nyid stong pa nyid la rgyal po gnyis dang 'dra ba'i spang gnyen gnyis 'thab pa'o// gang la 'thab na/ rang gi mngon par 'dod pa'i don la 'thab bo/ tshul ji ltar 'thab na/ dang por las mi 'thu ba dang 'dra bar dad pa dang brtson 'grus la sogs pa'i gnyen po gsog dmag bsags nas 'thab pa dang 'dra bar gnyen po dad pa la sogs pa'am/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsags nas spang bya rtog pa dang 'thab ste/ 'khor gsum du rtog pa nam skyes kyi dus su gcod/ gnyen pos sleb par byed do// ru shom pa dang 'dra bar gnyen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug tshan tshan du bsdeb/ dmag dpon dang 'dra ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis gnyen po sdeb par byed/ mda' 'phen pa dang 'dra bar rnam par rtog pa'i dgra nam byung ba'i dus su gnyen po stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis slebs par byed/ de nas pha rol po'i dmag pham par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ gnyen pos mi mthun phyogs rtog pa rnams pham par mdzad nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes la dbang bsgyur bar mdzad do// nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa la gang nas 'byung*/ gang 'byung*/ ji ltar 'byung*/

gang du 'byung*/ gang gis 'bras bu 'byung snyam na/ dang po ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di nas 'byung ngo*// gang 'byung na/ sher phyin gyi gdams ngag ldan zhing*/ nyams su len pa'i gang zag rnams 'byung ngo*// ji ltar 'byung na/ khams gsum gyi rtog pa bcad nas 'byung ngo*// mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzod yul du khyer te 'byung*/ dregs pa can nga rgyal bcag nas 'byung*/ skyon can gyi mtshang gcod nas 'byung*/ zhum pa'i mdun bsu nas 'byung*/ spang bya dang gnyen po sbyar nas 'byung*/ chos ka sa nas byed kyin 'byung*/ lam mi bde sa nas 'chos kyin 'byung*/ 'phrang dog sa nas sel gyin 'byung*/ nad sdig sgrib kyi phyags shing du khyer nas 'byung*/ phar phyin drug gcod bskyed gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len nas 'byung*/ lam lnga rgyud la sbyor gyin 'byung*/ gdul bya la snying rjes phan 'dogs pa'i sgo nas 'byung*/ lam log pa bsgyur gyin 'byung*/ 'khyogs na srong gin 'byung*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul du 'byung*/ theg pa dman pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ngo*// gang du 'byung ba na/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das par 'byung ngo*// nges 'byung sgrub pa rdzogs pa'i rjes thogs su/ rnam rtog gi ri bo bsnyil/ 'khor ba'i chu rgyun skams/ 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du byas nas/ phrin las kyis sems can gyi don byed do// de yang tshogs lam gyi dus su/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog sbyor lam gyi dus su zag bcas dang zag med kyi sa mtshams su 'byed pa'i nges 'byed cha bzhi rim gyis thob nas/ sa dang por byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis bden pa mthong*/ 'khor ba'i sa bon rtsad nas bcad/ khams gsum du mi ldog pa'i gdeng thob/ sgom lam gyi dus su 'phags lam yan lag brgyad thob nas/ theg pa dman pa'i 'jigs pa las rim gyis grol/

sgom lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i rjes thogs su/ kun du 'od kyi sar rang don chos sku thob nas/ gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis kyi phrin las kyis dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i don mdzad do// 'bras bu sku gsum la/ dang po ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stobs sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa'o// 'di ni sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul yin gyi/ sa bcu pa man chad kyis ji lta ba bzhin dngos su mi rig go /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan cing*/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang thabs cig tu theg pa chen po'i chos la longs spyod pa'o// sprul pa'i sku ni/ sprul pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can dag ma dag sna tshogs kyi don mdzad pa'o// longs sku'i zhing khams ni/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams so// sprul sku'i zhing khams
